verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's own docs describe cross-session memory: the agent writes durable plain-Markdown memory files to its workspace (docs-97, docs-24, docs-58). An Active Memory feature handles rule-based recall and escalates to deep conversation-history recall when needed (docs-119), backed by persistent SQLite session history (docs-25). The caveat that the model only remembers what gets saved to disk (docs-24) leaves it unclear how automatic the writing is. missing for 10: explicit documentation that memory writes happen automatically rather than on request, independent or hands-on corroboration that recall works reliably for everyday users.
